verdict: A 3-day ad blackout crushed this week's leads; the 28-day base holds.
narrative: This past week was significantly disrupted: September 12, 13, and 16 all recorded zero ad spend and zero leads, creating a three-day delivery blackout that accounts for the near-total drop in weekly lead volume. Over the full 28-day window your numbers remain solid — 77 leads at $8.60 per lead — but that strong base is being eroded if the blackout days are not addressed immediately. The spend issue has been identified and delivery is being restored to prevent further lost days. Separately, 79 leads entered your pipeline this period but no appointments were booked; we are reviewing the intake process to ensure leads that arrive are being followed up and converted to scheduled patients. With delivery stabilized, next week's lead volume should recover toward the 28-day daily average.
